battle.name: 入侵埃蘭
battle.brief: 約前2270年，薩爾貢自阿加德沿底格里斯河谷東進，攻破埃蘭首都蘇薩與西部城邑烏魯阿、阿拉瓦，擊潰四位埃蘭首領，迫馬哈西與蘇薩諸王入朝為臣。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝銅矛工藝，與本役兩軍所持的套接銅矛同源，惟非本役出土之物。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是阿卡德王國在薩爾貢治下向東發動的一場征服戰役，交戰的兩方是兩河流域下游的新王權與伊朗西南部胡齊斯坦平原上的埃蘭王國。薩爾貢一方是剛以武力終結蘇美爾城邦時代的新國家：首都阿加德設有王宮與官署，國王以「基什之王」的名號發號施令，軍隊由職業步兵、弓手、斧兵與投石手組成，常備隊伍約五千四百人，佔領區則設「總督」（sakkanakku）接管行政，並以神授王權作為統治的合法性來源。埃蘭一方是一個以蘇薩為中心的王國，由阿萬王朝統治，崇奉因舒什伊納克，境內除蘇薩等城邑外還聯結了東部的山地國馬哈西（帕拉什姆），並借波斯灣的航路與迪穆恩、馬甘相通。第三方是阿加德碼頭停泊的美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩商船所代表的沿海南北貿易圈。兩邊的關係因此不是單純的族裔對抗，而是兩河王權與伊朗高原門戶在同一條銅料與木材通道上的角力。
countriesEn: This war was a campaign of conquest launched eastward by the kingdom of Akkad under Sargon, fought between the new kingship of the lower Mesopotamian plain and the kingdom of Elam on the Khuzestan plain in south-western Iran. Sargon's side was a new state that had just ended the age of the Sumerian city-states by force: the capital at Agade housed the palace and the royal offices, the king issued his orders in the name of 'King of Kish', the army consisted of professional infantry, archers, axe-men and slingers, the standing force numbered about 5,400 men, and in the occupied districts governors (sakkanakku) were installed to take over the administration, with divinely sanctioned kingship serving as the source of legitimacy. Elam's side was a kingdom centred on Susa and ruled by the Awan dynasty; it worshipped Inshushinak, and beyond the cities of Susiana itself it was linked to the mountain country of Marhasi (Parahshum) in the east and reached the gulf trade through Dilmun and Magan. The third party was the north-south trading circle represented by the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun lying at the quay of Agade. The relationship between the two sides was therefore not a simple ethnic confrontation but a contest between the riverine kingship and the gateway of the Iranian plateau over one and the same corridor of copper and timber.
people: 薩爾貢是這場戰爭唯一的策劃者與敘述者。他留下的年名中有兩個專門記錄東線：「摧毀埃蘭之年」與「摧毀烏魯阿、阿拉瓦之年」，後者指的是埃蘭最西部的城區。他的王銜銘文寫著自己是「世界之王、埃蘭與帕拉什姆的征服者」，並點名被擊敗的埃蘭之王盧胡伊什安——希什布拉西尼之子，這是本場戰爭中唯一留下名字的埃蘭君主；另一個被記錄的名字是馬哈西將領西德高，此人後來又出現在其子里穆什的銘文裡，說明東線的抵抗在他死後仍未停止。埃蘭方面的另外三位首領在阿卡德文獻裡沒有留下名字，只記錄了他們所代表的城邑與首領體系。阿卡德方面，薩爾貢的兒子基丁胡特拉恩後來坐上蘇薩與埃蘭的王位，被安插為附庸君主；里穆什與馬尼什圖什先後繼承王位並被迫收拾東方的殘局。考古學家雅克·德·摩爾根於一九〇一至一九〇二年在蘇薩衛城發掘，發現了被認作薩爾貢或里穆什的青銅頭像與勝利石碑殘段，本場戰役的物質證據主要出自那次考古與其後法國考古隊的接續發掘。
peopleEn: Sargon was the sole planner and narrator of this war. Two of his regnal year names are devoted to the eastern front: the year in which he destroyed Elam and the year in which he destroyed Uru'a/Arawa, the latter referring to the far western districts of Elam. His royal titulary calls him 'Sargon, king of the world, conqueror of Elam and Parahshum', and it names the defeated king of Elam, Luh-uh-ish-an, son of Hishibrasini, the only Elamite ruler whose name survives from this war. The other name on record is Sidga'u, general of Marhasi, who reappears in an inscription of Sargon's son Rimush, which shows that resistance on the eastern front did not end with Sargon's death. The other three Elamite leaders left no names behind in the Akkadian documents, which record only the cities and the system of chiefdom that they represented. On the Akkadian side, Sargon's son Kidin-Hutran later took the throne of Susa and Elam as an installed vassal ruler, while Rimush and Manishtushu succeeded in turn and were obliged to clean up the mess in the east. The material evidence for this campaign comes mainly from archaeology: Jacques de Morgan excavated the Susa acropolis in 1901–1902 and found the bronze head identified as Sargon or Rimush together with fragments of a victory stele, and the French archaeological missions that continued afterwards in the same decades added to the record.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝工藝：銅或青銅矛頭以綁紮或銲接固定在木杆前端，埃及人用它守城垣、也用它收復失地。它與本役相隔約五千年，並不出現在蘇薩與胡齊斯坦這條戰線上；但兩軍步兵手中的刺擊兵器正是同一條技術譜系的產物：套接式銅矛頭裝在木杆上，刃形作柳葉或菱形，與矩形或圓形的覆皮盾牌、雙刃銅斧、象首斧、短匕首、銅鎬、複合弓與投石索配合使用；箭鏈以銅或骨製，蘇薩出土的箭鏈與箭桿殘件可以對證。攻城方面靠木槌、撞槌、柴堆、繩索與壕溝，阿卡德王室的記載還提到切斷敵城水源、修壩引水的做法，後來的阿卡德勝利石碑把水壩刻成攻防的記號。運輸沒有戰車——戰車要到前二千年代才出現在兩河流域，薩爾貢的軍隊靠牛拉的四輪載具（蘇薩一期已見車）與徒步隊伍，糧食、薪柴與飲水靠底格里斯河的水運和沿途徵發。就金屬而言，當時的銅來自波斯灣的烏魯米那與阿曼方向的馬甘，這條原料通道正是阿卡德東進、埃蘭壯大的共同理由。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on this card belongs to Early Dynastic craftwork: a copper or bronze head fixed to the front of a wooden shaft by lashing or riveting, used by the Egyptians to defend city walls and to recover lost ground. It is separated from this campaign by roughly five thousand years and does not appear on the Susa–Khuzestan front; but the thrusting weapons in the hands of the infantry of both armies were products of exactly the same technological lineage: socketed copper spearheads mounted on wooden shafts, with willow-leaf or lozenge shaped blades, used together with rectangular or round leather-covered shields, double-bladed copper axes, axe-heads in the form of elephant tusks, short daggers, copper adzes, composite bows and slings; arrowheads were made of copper or bone, and arrowheads and shaft fragments recovered at Susa bear this out. Siege work relied on wooden mallets, battering rams, brushwood piles, ropes and trenches, and the Akkadian royal texts also mention cutting the water supply of an enemy city and building dams to divert it, a practice that later Akkadian victory stelae render as the motif of the dam. There were no war chariots in the transport system — chariots did not reach Mesopotamia until the early second millennium — so Sargon's army moved on foot and on ox-drawn four-wheeled wagons (already known at Susa in the Susa I period), while grain, firewood and drinking water came by river transport on the Tigris and by requisition along the route. As for metals, the copper of the time came from Dilmun in the Persian Gulf and from Magan in the direction of Oman; that supply corridor was the common reason behind Akkadian expansion eastward and Elamite strength.
tactics: 從阿卡德留下的動詞裡可以看出，這是一條由西向東、逐城攻取的推進線，而不是一次會戰：薩爾貢自阿加德出發，沿底格里斯河谷上行，再折入胡齊斯坦的卡爾赫與迪茲水系，下到蘇薩盆地。每一城的標準程序是：先以弓手與攻城器材壓制城頭，同時切斷城內水源迫其屈服，繼而以持盾持矛的方陣貼牆作業，斧兵與撞槌破門，最後由缺口突入並搜掠城中物資。薩爾貢自記一生攻克三十四城，卻沒有留下逐城的編制與傷亡記錄。進攻埃蘭的同時，軍隊並未放棄海路：阿加德碼頭同時停泊美盧哈、馬甘與迪穆恩的船，說明遠征的補給與政治宣傳同時走陸路與海路。對手方面，埃蘭與馬哈西的抵抗以守城與山地嚮導的襲擾為主，馬哈西位於通往伊朗高原的山口，這種游擊使阿卡德的縱隊必須不斷分兵護路。佔領之後是編戶齊民：總督入駐、登記土地與人口、徵發穀物與勞役，這套後勤與治理能力，才是阿卡德能把戰線推出近五百公里的真正原因。
tacticsEn: From the verbs preserved in the Akkadian texts one can see that this was a line of advance running from west to east and taking city after city, not a single pitched battle: Sargon set out from Agade, moved up the Tigris valley, turned into the Karkheh and Dez watercourses of Khuzestan and descended into the plain of Susa. The standard procedure at each city was to bring archers and siege equipment to bear on the walls while cutting the water supply of the town to force its surrender, then to press shield-and-spear formations up against the walls while axe-men and rams broke the gates, and finally to enter through the breach and strip the city of its goods. Sargon claims for himself thirty-four cities conquered in all, but he left no record of the order of battle or the losses of any single engagement. While he was campaigning against Elam the army did not abandon the sea route: the ships of Meluhha, Magan and Dilmun lay together at the quay of Agade, which shows that the logistics of the expedition and its political advertisement travelled by land and by water at the same time. On the enemy side, Elamite and Marhasian resistance consisted mainly in holding walled towns and in harassment led by mountain guides; Marhasi lay on the passes leading to the Iranian plateau, and this kind of guerrilla action forced the Akkadian column to split off detachments to guard its roads continuously. After the taking of a town came registration and assessment: a governor was installed, land and population were recorded, grain and labour were requisitioned, and this apparatus of logistics and government is the real reason why Akkad could push its front line out by nearly five hundred kilometres.
data: 可核對的數字有這些：薩爾貢的王室銘文自記一生攻克三十四城，並以五千四百人的常備隊伍「每天在我面前吃麵包」著稱於尼普爾銘文；東征方面可確定的是四名埃蘭首領被擊敗，其中一人是阿萬王朝之王，兩座被年名記錄下來的埃蘭城是蘇薩與西部城區的烏魯阿、阿拉瓦。年代上，中年表把薩爾貢的統治定在前2334至前2279年，本卡標出的前2270年正落在他在位的末段，隨後即由里穆什繼位；蘇美爾王表則分別給出三十四年或五十六年兩種在位年數，而有紀年可查的年名只有四個。地理上，蘇薩（今伊朗胡齊斯坦省舒什）約在北緯三十二度二分、東經四十八度十五分，阿加德的確切位置未定，一般認為在幼發拉底河中游西帕爾一帶，與蘇薩直線相距約四百五十公里，若順河谷再折向胡齊斯坦，行程當在六百公里以上。考古旁證包括蘇薩衛城出土的薩爾貢時期勝利石碑殘段與那具青銅頭像，後者的出土地與傳統認定之間存在爭議。至今沒有任何遺址被認定為此役的戰場，銘文也沒有留下確切日期、雙方死傷與攻城器械的數目。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are these: Sargon's royal inscriptions claim thirty-four cities conquered over his career, and the Nippur inscription is famous for a standing force of 5,400 men who 'ate bread daily before him'. On the eastern front it is certain that four Elamite leaders were defeated, one of them the king of the Awan dynasty, and that the two Elamite towns recorded in the year names were Susa and the western city district of Uru'a/Arawa. As to chronology, the Middle Chronology places Sargon's reign at 2334–2279 BC, and the 2270 BC of this card falls in the closing decade of his rule, immediately before Rimush succeeded him; the Sumerian King List gives two different reign lengths, thirty-four and fifty-six years, while only four year names with dated attestations are known. Geographically Susa, modern Shush in Khuzestan province, lies at about 32.2 degrees north and 48.25 degrees east; the exact site of Agade is unknown, and it is generally placed near Sippar on the middle Euphrates, some 450 kilometres from Susa in a straight line, and considerably more than 600 kilometres along the river valley and the turn across to Khuzestan. The archaeological evidence includes fragments of a Sargonic victory stele and that bronze head excavated on the Susa acropolis, between whose place of find and its traditional identification there is a genuine dispute. No site has been identified as the battlefield of this campaign, and the inscriptions preserve no exact date, no casualty figures for either side and no counts of siege equipment.
cause: 起因是多層的。最表層是地緣：埃蘭扼住波斯灣通伊朗高原的門戶，蘇薩一帶控制著海路與陸路的交會，是銅料、木材、石料與其他原料的集散地；阿卡德要成為兩河的強權，就不能容忍東方另有一個能自立門戶的王國。第二層是新王權的內在需要：薩爾貢推翻基什的霸權、統一蘇美爾各城之後，需要能證明「四方之王」身分並且可以年年抽取的戰果與貢賦，東部是最合適的戰場。第三層是制度與觀念：阿卡德的王權把「世界之王」與「神所賜的國界」寫進銘文，埃蘭與馬哈西正是「上國」這個名號的指向；薩爾貢同時需要一位對外的主神作見證，達甘授予「上國」的敘事正是這套外交語言的一部分。最後是時機：埃蘭在蘇薩一期被拉伽爾王伊安納圖姆攻破之後沉寂了數百年，到薩爾貢時代重新成為獨立的強者，而阿卡德在其前線剛剛打平了南方與東方的反叛，東進便成了順理成章的一步。
causeEn: The causes operated on several levels. The most superficial is geography: Elam held the gateway from the Persian Gulf to the Iranian plateau, the district of Susa controlled the meeting point of the sea route and the land routes, and it was the collecting point for copper, timber, stone and other raw materials; if Akkad was to become the strong power of the two rivers, it could not tolerate an independent kingdom in the east able to stand on its own. The second level is the internal need of a new kingship: after Sargon had broken the hegemony of Kish and united the Sumerian cities, the dynasty required victories that would prove the title 'king of the four quarters' and could be drawn upon year after year, and the east offered the most suitable theatre for that. The third level is institution and belief: the Akkadian court wrote 'king of the world' and the 'borders granted by the gods' into its inscriptions, and Elam and Marhasi were precisely what the title 'upper land' pointed at; Sargon also needed a god to witness his claims abroad, and the narrative in which Dagan grants him the upper land is part of that diplomatic language. Finally there was the opportunity: after Elam had been broken in the Susa I period by Eannatum of Lagash it had lain quiet for several centuries, and by the time of Sargon it had re-emerged as an independent power, while Akkad had only just pacified revolt in the south and the east, so that a march to the east was the natural next step.
impact: 直接後果是埃蘭與馬哈西被壓入阿卡德的附庸體系：蘇薩與馬哈西的總督、總督轄地與諸王成為阿卡德的臣屬，埃蘭的物資沿底格里斯河與波斯灣的航線向兩河輸送，阿卡德的王權第一次把疆界伸到伊朗高原的邊緣。制度上的收穫更為長遠：附庸君主基丁胡特拉恩被安置在蘇薩，王族直接占據埃蘭王座的做法，開啟了此後數百年阿卡德／巴比倫與埃蘭之間的「宗主—附庸」模式，直到前一千九百年前後舒特魯克納胡恩特反過來洗掠巴比倫與阿卡德才被徹底倒轉。文化上，埃蘭吸收了美索不達米亞的圓筒印章與聖獸圖像母題，蘇薩的繪畫陶藝與青銅頭像一類的王室肖像都帶著帝國時期的痕跡；薩爾貢的勝利石碑殘段在蘇薩出土，說明埃蘭王室收藏並再使用了征服者的宣傳物，而那具青銅頭像究竟在本役被掠走、還是其後埃蘭人破阿卡德時帶走，至今仍是沒有定論的問題。這場戰役的長期代價，則要在王朝覆亡時才會顯現。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that Elam and Marhasi were pressed into the Akkadian system of vassalage: the governors, governorates and kings of Susa and Marhasi became subjects of Akkad, the produce of Elam was carried towards the two rivers along the Tigris and the gulf shipping lanes, and for the first time the Akkadian kingship extended its borders to the edge of the Iranian plateau. The institutional gain was longer lived: the vassal ruler Kidin-Hutran was installed at Susa, and the practice of occupying the Elamite throne with a member of the royal family opened the pattern of suzerainty between Akkad/Babylon and Elam that ran for several centuries, and was only reversed when Shutruk-Nahhunte sacked Babylon and Akkad around 1900 BC. Culturally, Elam took over Mesopotamian cylinder-seal iconography and the repertoire of sacred animals, and the painted pottery of Susa and its royal portraits in the shape of bronze heads carry the marks of the imperial period. Fragments of a Sargonic victory stele were excavated at Susa, which shows that the Elamite court collected and reused the propaganda of its conqueror; whether the bronze head was taken away in this campaign or carried off later by Elamites when they broke into Akkad remains an open question. The long-term cost of this campaign only became visible when the dynasty fell.
result: 結果寫在薩爾貢自己的句子裡：埃蘭被攻破，四位首領被擊敗，蘇薩與西部城邑被洗劫，蘇薩、馬哈西與鄰近地區的總督、總督轄地與諸王成為阿卡德的附庸；他於是自稱「世界之王、埃蘭與帕拉什姆的征服者」，並以「摧毀埃蘭之年」與「摧毀烏魯阿、阿拉瓦之年」兩個年名把這場戰爭記在王朝的年表上。從軍事看，這是一場沒有敗績的勝利：銘文通篇只記進攻與摧毀，沒有一次敗北。從政治看，阿卡德得到一條通向波斯灣與伊朗高原的走廊、一批可供再分配的城市與人口，以及一個由王室血脈直接占據的埃蘭王座。從持久性看，成果極短暫：里穆什與馬尼什圖什仍須對付馬哈西將領西德高一線的抵抗，前2150年上下古提人攻入兩河、阿卡德王朝覆亡，東方的附庸體系隨之瓦解。最終的結局是相反的：前2000年前後，埃蘭王舒特魯克納胡恩特率軍溯底格里斯河而下，洗掠巴比倫與阿卡德，前2270年阿卡德在東方的優勢被徹底抵銷；本場戰役留下的真正遺產，是薩爾貢的王權語言與埃蘭王室的雙重政治記憶。
resultEn: The result is written in Sargon's own sentences: Elam was broken, four of its leaders were defeated, Susa and the western towns were stripped, and the governors, governorates and kings of Susa, Marhasi and the neighbouring districts became vassals of Akkad; he accordingly called himself 'Sargon, king of the world, conqueror of Elam and Parahshum', and entered the war in the dynastic year list under the two names 'the year in which he destroyed Elam' and 'the year in which he destroyed Uru'a/Arawa'. Militarily this was a victory without a single recorded defeat: the inscriptions speak only of attack and destruction, never of a reverse. Politically Akkad gained a corridor running to the Persian Gulf and the Iranian plateau, a set of cities and populations available for redistribution, and an Elamite throne occupied directly by royal blood. As for durability, the results were very short-lived: Rimush and Manishtushu still had to deal with resistance on the Marhasi front around Sidga'u, and around 2150 BC the Gutians entered the two rivers, the Akkadian dynasty fell, and the system of eastern vassals dissolved with it. The final outcome ran in the opposite direction: around 2000 BC the Elamite king Shutruk-Nahhunte marched down the Tigris and sacked Babylon and Akkad, cancelling out Akkad's advantage in the east altogether, and the true legacy of this campaign is the double political memory of Sargon's royal language and of the Elamite court.
